entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. H.S.Rathore, counsel for the respondent/State.
Heard on IA No.18329 of 2024 which is an application for urgent hearing.
For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
Accordingly, IA No.18329 of 2024 stands disposed of.
Also heard on the question of admission.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Record has been received.

Also heard on IA No.18330/2024 which is second application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant - Narayan S/o Shri Kanhaiyalal @ Kaniram Mali.

The appellant - Narayan has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(M) of IPC, 1860 and Sections 3(1)(w-i), 3(1)(w-ii) & 3(2)
(v) of SC/ST (PA) Act, 1989 and sentenced to undergo RI of 10 years and 02 years each and Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.2000/-, Rs.1000/- and Rs.500/- each with further default stipulation.
Counsel for the appellant submits that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the aforesaid offence.
He further submits that he filed the application after completion of five years of jail sentence of present appellant.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and the final hearing of this appeal would take long time to conclude.
Hence the remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
Per contra, counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application and prays for 2 CRA-8253-2022 its rejection.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Taking into consideration the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the custody period of appellant as well as record, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence and grant the benefit of suspension to appellant.
Accordingly, IA No.18330/2024 stands allowed.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant Narayan S/o Shri Kanhaiyalal @ Kaniram Mali is hereby suspended and it is ordered that the appellant No.1 be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of trial court and subject to depositing of the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 14.05.2025 and also on such further dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
List the appeal for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
(VIVEK RUSIA)

JUDGE   Arun/-
